view.sentence: On BEAM-10M, with the same three answer models and 8,000 tokens of each system's own evidence, `ext-temporal-graph` scored 55.6% and gbrain-defaults 73.4% (difference 17.9 points, 95% interval 9.4 to 27.3 points). The preregistered power check found these conversations detect only differences of about 13.6 points, so this describes the systems and does not rank them.

`baseline-hybrid` did not run on BEAM-10M: invalid (A5): the A1 unit ran Q1's definition of this cell id (four arms, Sonnet reader replicates, frontier judges, judge repeats) instead of F6's single 8,000-token arm, because the cell runner resolved an id that both cell manifests define from Q1's manifest first. Separately, 6 of its 10 conversations ingested degraded: the hybrid baseline sent sessions longer than the embedding model's 8,192-token input limit, the provider refused them (17 failed sessions), and /finish never reported ready. The cell then hit its unit timeout with 300 of the 8,000-token arm's 1,000 promised answers. None of its rows are published..

On BEAM-10M, with the same three answer models and 8,000 tokens of each system's own evidence, `ext-extract-first` scored 68.8% and gbrain-defaults 73.4% (difference 4.7 points, 95% interval 0.3 to 9.3 points). The preregistered power check found these conversations detect only differences of about 13.6 points, so this describes the systems and does not rank them.

On BEAM-10M, with the same three answer models and 8,000 tokens of each system's own evidence, `ext-memory-bank` scored 66.9% and gbrain-defaults 73.4% (difference 6.5 points, 95% interval -0.9 to 14.5 points). The preregistered power check found these conversations detect only differences of about 13.6 points, so this describes the systems and does not rank them.

`ext-graph-pipeline` did not run on BEAM-10M: the product's own behavior (Q1 A23, reused from A24): its graph store's hard-coded 32 GiB size limit, once reached, fails every later write and retrieval, and its incremental re-extraction makes each session cost more; three shards ingested for 62 hours without finishing.
`ext-markdown-kb` did not run on BEAM-10M: projected ~61 h > 48 h limit per conversation (Q1 A23, reused from A24: the product's own reindex cost grows with the square of the chunk count).

The preregistered power check found these conversations detect only differences of about 13.6 points, so this describes the systems and does not rank them.

The preregistered power check found these conversations detect only differences of about 13.6 points, so this describes the systems and does not rank them.

On BEAM-10M, with the same three answer models and 8,000 tokens of each system's own evidence, strict recall of all gold sessions at 10 was 29.1% for gbrain-defaults and 10.5% for `ext-temporal-graph` (difference 18.6 points, 95% interval 3.8 to 33.1 points, Holm-adjusted p 0.162); a retrieval diagnostic, not an answer claim.
